objective: Find nuclease variants with activity above the wild type over four screening rounds, then rank unseen variants by activity class.

measurements.name: activity_class
measurements.description: Ordered catalytic activity call from droplet sorting: 0 non-functional, 1 above background, 2 above the wild type, 3 above the best known single substitution (A73R).

deliverable.description: UTF-8 JavaScript defining a deterministic, pointwise predict(sequence) that returns one finite number; larger means a higher predicted activity class

design_space.description: 20000 nuclease variants carrying 2 to 11 substitutions; every round orders from the same pool and each variant may be screened at most once in the campaign
design_space.rules: every stage orders from the same catalog; each design can be measured at most once
